ops.title: Let a branch marketplace carry an optional commit, so a moving upstream branch stops invalidating the inventory hash
ops.description:
Problem. claude.marketplaces[] takes exactly one of ref and branch (internal/images/inventory.go:137-138, validated at :601-603). A ref is a 40-digit commit that cc-remote fetches into its own checkout and registers as a directory. claude-plugins-official cannot use it: Claude Code refuses a directory source for that reserved name and cannot clone a commit, so it must be a branch, registered as owner/repo#branch (docs/tool-inventory.md:92-99; images/plugins.sh:346-348). A branch has no commit pin. The monorepo inventory therefore holds its own prepare guard that hard-codes the clone's HEAD (monorepo tools/cc-remote/inventory.yaml:568-569 on dev at 2026-10-10). When the upstream head moves, that guard fails, the expected sha is edited, the inventory hash changes, and both Namespace images and the Sprites payload are rebuilt. Root ruled on 2026-10-10 to keep that guard until this exists, because it is the only thing holding the marketplace to known content.

Change. Add an optional commit on a branch marketplace. After images/plugins.sh registers the marketplace at its branch, it fetches that commit into the clone and detaches the clone at it. Verify compares the clone's HEAD with the commit, beside the registration and declaration checks it already makes. An upstream move then neither fails a build nor edits the inventory; the pin moves only when someone bumps it. plugins.sh is an input of the tools fingerprint (internal/images/render.go:337), so this change itself costs one payload and image rebuild.

Related finding, recorded here so it is not lost. A Sprites payload built on any machine other than a Sprite passes every check that exists and fails only at its first mount. The tools fingerprint is computed on the launcher from the rendered scripts (internal/workspace/payload.go:105, internal/images/render.go:337). The monorepo's payload-url validate checks pin shape and the inventory hash only (tools/cc-remote/payload-url:19-36), and CI re-hashes the two stored objects (tools/cc-remote/produce-agents-payload.sh). Nothing mounts the payload. The pack writes the build machine's home, arch, and OS version into the manifest (images/provision.sh:660), a mount refuses any mismatch (:497-508), and check_base refuses a machine whose base package list differs from the one the packages archive was captured against (:123-139). cc-remote payload build is Sprite-only today for that reason and two code ones: only the Sprites provider can download a file from a machine (internal/workspace/payload.go:54-57, internal/providers/sprites/sprites.go:291), and BuildPayload always creates its own fresh machine at the provider (payload.go:85) and refuses an image-booted profile (:63-65).

ops.text: A branch marketplace with a commit installs with its clone detached at that commit, and verify fails when HEAD differs
The monorepo inventory pins claude-plugins-official by commit and drops its prepare head guard
